definitions.explanation: Complete absence of light; extremely dark.
Figuratively, a situation with no hope or prospect of improvement.

examples.japanese: ⟦{部屋|へや}→部屋：00507_heya⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{真|ま}っ{暗|くら}だ。
⟦{停電|ていでん}→停電：03544_teiden⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{部屋|へや}→部屋：00507_heya⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{真|ま}っ{暗|くら}になった。
examples.english: The room went pitch dark due to the power outage.

examples.japanese: {真|ま}っ{暗|くら}な⟦{夜道|よみち}→夜道：17541_yomichi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{一人|ひとり}→一人：00630_hitori⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{歩|ある}く→歩く：00538_aruku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{怖|こわ}い→怖い：00864_kowai⟧。
examples.english: It's scary to walk alone on a pitch-dark road at night.

examples.japanese: ⟦{将来|しょうらい}→将来：01438_shourai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{真|ま}っ{暗|くら}だ。
⟦{将来|しょうらい}→将来：01438_shourai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{真|ま}っ{暗|くら}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{見|み}える→見える：01165_mieru⟧。
⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{見|み}つから→見つかる：01173_mitsukaru⟧ず、お⟦{先|さき}→先：02883_saki⟧{真|ま}っ{暗|くら}な{気持|きも}ちになった。
examples.english: I couldn't find a job and felt like the future was completely hopeless.

notes:
ETYMOLOGY:
{真|ま}っ (emphatic prefix) + ⟦{暗|くら}い→暗い：00647_kurai⟧ (dark) → {暗|くら}

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- ⟦{先行|さきゆ}き→先行き：27497_sakiyuki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{真|ま}っ{暗|くら} - the outlook is bleak
- {真|ま}っ{暗|くら}{闇|やみ} - complete darkness
- ⟦{目|め}の{前|まえ}→目の前：22588_menomae⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{真|ま}っ{暗|くら}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧ - to black out; to despair

USAGE:
When used figuratively, {真|ま}っ{暗|くら} describes a hopeless situation where one cannot see any positive future.
